idea: An eyepiece looks at one small specimen after another, a fern, cells, rings of light, until the last thing in it is the moon and the lens pulls out into the open sky.
leave: Looking closely at small things can lead you all the way to the sky.
subject: what fills the round eyepiece

device.what: a round eyepiece with a ticked rim that stays in the middle of the frame while the plate inside it changes every two beats
device.why: the fixed circle makes a fern, a cell and the moon look like the same kind of thing, which is the point of the film

change.from: an empty eyepiece ring on a dark frame
change.to: onion-skin cells filling the eyepiece, after a fern frond
a diatom in the eyepiece, after a star chart and an agate slice
the eyepiece gone and the moon small in a wide dusk sky

change.from: the moon in a dusk sky with drifting clouds
change.to: 一镜之内 and 从一片蕨叶，看到月亮 written at the left of the sky
